description: Give the build step line that mounts the installer's wheel cache as a cache. DISTILL-CANARY-e13a85c7

files.deps/cache-mount-cards.tsv:
wheel-cache-mount	RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/pip pip install -r requirements.txt	--mount=type=cache,id=pip,target=/root/.cache/pip
wheels-from-context	RUN --mount=type=bind,target=/root/.cache/pip pip install -r requirements.txt	--mount=type=bind,target=/root/.cache/pip
files.README.md:
# Stillwater Cartography - map service image

Built nightly on a runner that keeps the build cache between builds.
The dependency step is carded in deps/cache-mount-cards.tsv.
files.notes/runner-notes.txt:
Release notes:
The installer reads and writes its wheel cache under /root/.cache/pip.
That directory must be reused by the next build and must not appear in any layer.

turns.prompt: Stillwater Cartography builds its map service image nightly on a runner that keeps the build cache between builds.
